title: Photo Inspection Requirements for Physical Damage Coverage
content:
Every package of the Physical Damage Coverage (Comprehensive and Collision) requires a photo inspection of the vehicle after the coverage is added. The only package term that differs is the number of calendar days after the coverage effective date within which the inspection must be received.

| Package | Inspection required | Inspection due days (calendar days after the coverage effective date) |
|---|---|---|
| Cardinal Point Physical Damage $2,500 Deductible | Yes | 5 |
| Cardinal Point Physical Damage $2,000 Deductible | Yes | 5 |
| Cardinal Point Physical Damage $1,500 Deductible | Yes | 7 |
| Cardinal Point Physical Damage $1,000 Deductible | Yes | 7 |
| Cardinal Point Physical Damage $500 Deductible | Yes | 10 |
| Cardinal Point Physical Damage $250 Comprehensive / $500 Collision Deductible | Yes | 10 |

### Terms identical in every package

- **Complete photo set.** A complete inspection is made up of four photos: the four corners of the vehicle, the odometer reading, the VIN plate and the windshield.
- **Waiver.** The inspection is waived for a new vehicle with a dealer bill of sale dated within 7 days of the coverage effective date.
- **Removal when the inspection is not received in time.** The removal takes effect at 12:01 a.m. on the day after the inspection due date.
- **Loss before inspection.** A loss before the inspection is approved is covered for the damage from that loss. Payment is held until the inspection photos are received.

### Example on hypothetical dates

Take a coverage on the Cardinal Point Physical Damage $500 Deductible package whose effective date is the first day of a month. Ten calendar days after that is the eleventh, which is the inspection due date. If no inspection has been received by then, the removal takes effect at 12:01 a.m. on the twelfth.
